props.body: Synthetic retry budget is three attempts.

cypher: CREATE VECTOR INDEX ssg_embedding ON :Embedded(embedding) WITH CONFIG {"dimension": 4, "capacity": 32, "metric": "cos"}
name: create-vector-index

cypher: CALL vector_search.search('ssg_embedding', 12, $v) YIELD node,similarity RETURN node.key AS key,similarity ORDER BY similarity DESC,key
name: vector-search

cypher: MATCH (n:Embedded) RETURN n.key AS key,vector_search.cosine_similarity(n.embedding,$v) AS similarity ORDER BY similarity DESC,key
name: ssg-exact-cosine

cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH p=(n:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[:CORRECTS|SUPERSEDES|SUPPORTED_BY*1..4]-(x) RETURN x.key AS key,[r IN relationships(p)|{type:type(r),source:r.asserting_source,hash:r.asserting_hash,channel:r.channel}] AS provenance,[r IN relationships(p)|type(r)] AS types ORDER BY key,types LIMIT 64
name: explain-replacement-evidence

cypher: MATCH p=(n:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[:CORRECTS|SUPERSEDES|SUPPORTED_BY*1..4]-(x) RETURN x.key AS key,[r IN relationships(p)|{type:type(r),source:r.asserting_source,hash:r.asserting_hash,channel:r.channel}] AS provenance,[r IN relationships(p)|type(r)] AS types ORDER BY key,types LIMIT 64
name: replacement-evidence

cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH (s:Scope {key:$scope})<-[:IN_SCOPE]-(n:RecordVersion) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:SUPPORTED_BY|ATTRIBUTED_TO|DERIVED_FROM]->(x) RETURN n.key AS key,collect(x.key) AS context ORDER BY key LIMIT 64
name: explain-component-attempts

cypher: MATCH (s:Scope {key:$scope})<-[:IN_SCOPE]-(n:RecordVersion) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:SUPPORTED_BY|ATTRIBUTED_TO|DERIVED_FROM]->(x) RETURN n.key AS key,collect(x.key) AS context ORDER BY key LIMIT 64
name: component-attempts

cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH p=(n:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[r*1..2]-(x) WHERE all(e IN r WHERE type(e) IN $types AND e.channel='recorded') RETURN DISTINCT x.key AS key,[e IN r|type(e)] AS types ORDER BY key,types LIMIT 32
name: explain-recorded-related

cypher: MATCH p=(n:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[r*1..2]-(x) WHERE all(e IN r WHERE type(e) IN $types AND e.channel='recorded') RETURN DISTINCT x.key AS key,[e IN r|type(e)] AS types ORDER BY key,types LIMIT 32
name: recorded-related

cypher:
EXPLAIN CALL vector_search.search('ssg_embedding', 12, $text) YIELD node, similarity
WITH node AS n, similarity
RETURN {heading: coalesce(n.title, n.id + ': ' + n.summary), key: n.key,
        type: coalesce(n.type, 'Advisory'), status: coalesce(n.status, 'imported'),
        body: coalesce(substring(n.body, 0, 600), ''),
        facts: {similarity: similarity,
                classes: [(n)-[:INDICATES]->(c:VulnClass) | c.key],
                packages: [(n)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(p:Package) | p.key] + [(n)-[:AFFECTS]->(p:Package) | p.key],
                symbols: [(n)-[:ON]->(s:Symbol) | coalesce(s.simple, s.prefix)] + [(n)-[:VULNERABLE_AT]->(s:Symbol) | s.simple],
                methods: [(n)-[:INDICATES]->(:VulnClass)<-[:ADDRESSES]-(m:Method) | m.key] + [(n)<-[:ADDRESSES]-(m:Method) | m.key],
                contrasts: [(n)-[:CONTRASTS]-(x:Facet) | x.kind + ' ' + x.key + ': ' + x.title]},
        next: CASE coalesce(n.type, '')
                WHEN 'Facet' THEN [{query: 'facet', params: '{"key":"' + n.key + '"}', when: 'read the facet in full'}]
                  + [(n)-[:CONTRASTS]-(x:Facet) | {query: 'facet', params: '{"key":"' + x.key + '"}', when: 'its ' + x.kind + ' counterpart: read both before deciding which one this code is'}]
                WHEN 'VulnClass' THEN [{query: 'class', params: '{"key":"' + n.key + '"}', when: 'what a claim of this class MUST show'}]
                WHEN 'Method' THEN [{query: 'method', params: '{"key":"' + n.key + '"}', when: 'follow the method'}]

cypher:
EXPLAIN MATCH (i:Investigation {key: $key})
CALL {
  WITH i
  RETURN {heading: i.title, key: i.key, type: i.type, status: i.status, body: i.body,
          facts: {posture: i.posture, docs: i.docs},
          next: [(i)-[s:SUGGESTS]->(q:Query) | {query: q.name, params: s.params, when: s.when}],
          source: i.source, digest: i.digest} AS item, 0 AS ord, '' AS k
  UNION ALL
  WITH i
  MATCH (i)-[:HAS_STEP]->(st:Step)
  RETURN {heading: 'Step ' + toString(st.order) + ': ' + st.title, key: st.key, type: 'Step', status: i.status,
          body: st.instructions,
          facts: {commands: st.commands, expect: st.expect,
                  uses: [(st)-[:USES]->(u:Unit) | u.key]},
          next: [(st)-[r:RUNS]->(q:Query) | {query: q.name, params: r.params, when: r.when}],
          source: i.source, digest: i.digest} AS item, st.order AS ord, st.key AS k
}
RETURN item, ord, k
ORDER BY ord, k
